notes: Working capital (NWC) definition used here: (Receivables + Inventories + Prepaid & other current assets) − (Accounts payable + Accrued & other current liabilities), excluding cash, excluding short-term debt/current maturities, and excluding assets/liabilities held for sale (where presented). ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))
EBIT is proxied by Operating income from the consolidated income statement. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))

WACC and terminal exit multiple are modeling assumptions (not explicitly provided as an audited input); WACC uses a market-data estimate as a starting point and terminal multiple is set to a mid-range peer-consistent level. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/xyl/statistics/))

NOL utilization percent is set to 0.80 due to lack of explicit disclosed utilization rate; NOL balance uses net operating loss carryforward attributes shown in the tax footnote. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))

The 'investments' field is set to null because the schema’s expected definition is pipeline-specific and the 10-K cash-flow lines (e.g., equity investments/cash paid for investments) are not mapped unambiguously to a single DCF 'investments' adjustment.

catalysts: Sustained delivery against FY2026 guidance (revenue/orders conversion and margin execution). ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/en-us/about-xylem/newsroom/press-releases/xylem-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results/))

Progress on portfolio simplification and productivity initiatives supporting ongoing operating leverage. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/en-us/about-xylem/newsroom/press-releases/xylem-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results/))
Potential M&A/divestiture activity that changes the growth mix and/or capital allocation profile.
company_overview: Xylem is a global water solutions company serving customer needs across the water cycle (drinking water delivery, wastewater collection/analysis, and return of water to the environment). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001524472/000152447226000012/xyl-20251231.htm))

Operates through Water Infrastructure, Applied Water Systems, Measurement and Control Solutions, and Water Solutions and Services segments. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))

Maintains a global installed base that supports recurring parts/replacement and service revenue streams. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001524472/000152447226000012/xyl-20251231.htm))

Sells through global distribution networks and channel partners serving customers in ~150 countries. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001524472/000152447226000012/xyl-20251231.htm))
current_context: FY2025 results: Revenue $9.035B and operating income (EBIT) $1.223B (operating margin 13.5%). ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))

Initiated FY2026 revenue guidance of ~$9.1B–$9.2B (up ~2%–4% organic) and adjusted EPS guidance of $5.35–$5.60. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/en-us/about-xylem/newsroom/press-releases/xylem-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results/))

Xylem highlighted productivity and price realization as drivers of margin expansion into 2026 outlook. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/en-us/about-xylem/newsroom/press-releases/xylem-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results/))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes low-to-mid single-digit revenue growth consistent with FY2026 guidance and supported by installed-base/services dynamics. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/en-us/about-xylem/newsroom/press-releases/xylem-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results/))

EBIT margin recovers/expands from FY2024 levels toward ~14% as cost actions and productivity savings sustain operating leverage. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))

Model uses steady reinvestment (capex ~3.7% of sales) and working-capital intensity consistent with historical NWC as a % of revenue. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))
Terminal value is anchored to a mid-teens EV/EBITDA exit multiple that aligns with the peer valuation band (proxy).
key_risks: Project timing/volume volatility and customer budget delays could impact revenue growth and near-term margin trajectory.
Restructuring and cost actions may not deliver the expected savings, or may increase charges/costs in subsequent periods.
Foreign exchange and tax-rate volatility could reduce earnings quality and alter effective cash tax rates.

presentation.subtitle: Xylem (XYL) DCF Inputs: Water Infrastructure & Services Growth
valuation_summary: DCF drivers are grounded in audited FY2023–FY2025 income statement and cash flow data, with base-case growth and margin expansion tied to the company’s FY2026 outlook. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))

Key capital-structure and tax inputs use FY2025 balance sheet values and FY2025 effective tax rate (~19.5%) as the starting point for normalization. ([xylem.com](https://www.xylem.com/siteassets/investors/2025-annual-report-on-form-10-k.pdf))

Selected terminal growth (2.0%) and exit multiple (15.0x) are intended to be economically consistent with stable long-run cash generation in water infrastructure/solutions and the observed peer multiple range. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/mwa/statistics/))
